work-1-longdesc: I developed an intelligent conversational assistant for the pharmaceutical and healthcare sector. The system leverages RAG architecture to ensure accurate, well-grounded responses, with a conversational engine optimized for technical and management queries. It includes a full-stack application and cloud infrastructure to ensure scalability and high availability.
work-1-challenges: Ensuring pharmaceutical/scientific rigor, minimizing hallucinations, integrating domain-specific knowledge sources, and meeting healthcare compliance requirements.
work-1-outcomes: An assistant that optimizes consultations and management workflows, delivering contextualized and traceable responses through RAG.
work-2-longdesc: Web platform for UFC fight analysis and simulation. Features secure authentication, data management, interactive statistics, and AI-powered predictions for comparative fighter analysis.
work-2-challenges: Processing and structuring fight data, designing useful predictive models, and delivering a clear UX for complex analysis.
work-2-outcomes: Interactive system enabling detailed analysis and predictive simulations to support informed decision-making.
work-3-longdesc: Complete data science pipeline for predictive analysis of consumer behavior. Processes over 540K records, applying feature engineering, training multiple models (LightGBM, XGBoost, Scikit-Learn), and visualization to extract actionable insights.
work-3-challenges: Handling large data volumes, selecting relevant features, optimizing models, and presenting results in an understandable way.
work-3-outcomes: Robust predictive model with a reproducible pipeline, enabling trend analysis and sales forecasting.
